answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the walnut of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors. Each submission hangs on the horizon of a task receipt, and the reef is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
